answer_1.quote: KG-to-text generation, automatically converting knowledge into comprehensive natural language, is an important task ... We tackle a practical problem of entity description generation by exploring KG.
answer_1.outputs: entity description paragraphs (e.g., first Wikipedia paragraph)

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we use several common evaluation metrics: BLEU, METEOR, TER, ROUGE 1, ROUGE 2, ROUGE L, PARENT.

answer_4.quote: We hire 6 annotators to evaluate the quality based on three evaluation metrics: fluency, grammar and authenticity.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each metric (fluency, grammar, authenticity) on a 1‑5 scale.
